events.title: Labor Norms in the Industrial Disputes Act
events.summary: India's Industrial Disputes Act (1947) imposes stringent conditions on the retrenchment of workers for firms with more than 300 employees. events.title: Library of Congress Constitution website missing Article I sections
events.summary: Reporters discovered that the online United States Constitution maintained by the Library of Congress was missing parts of Article I, which lays out the rights and duties of Congress. Missing sections included Congress's control over the District of Columbia, Congress's power to make laws, the promise that habeas corpus would not be suspended, the requirement that Congress appropriate all government spending, the prohibition on presidential acceptance of foreign gifts, and the specification that only Congress can levy tariffs. Officials attributed the deletions to "a coding error," and the missing sections were restored by the end of the day.
events.why_relevant: Deletion of foundational constitutional provisions regarding congressional power from the official government website, even if attributed to a technical error, represents a concerning gap in public access to the Constitution and raises questions about the integrity of official digital records.
events.basis: Today, reporters noticed that the online United States Constitution, maintained by the Library of Congress, was missing parts of Article I, the part of the Constitution that lays out the rights and duties of Congress. Parts of Section 8 and all of Sections 9 and 10 were gone.
events.act_key: library congress|deleted constitution sections|2025-08-06

events.title: Pentagon announces Confederate memorial restoration at Arlington National Cemetery
events.summary: The U.S. Army announced that restoring a Confederate memorial removed from Arlington National Cemetery will cost approximately $10 million. Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth announced the Pentagon would reinstall the memorial less than two years after it was removed on the recommendation of an independent commission, characterizing the original removal as the work of "woke lemmings."
events.why_relevant: The reversal of a commission-recommended removal of a Confederate memorial and the characterization of the prior decision as ideologically driven signals a shift in how the military addresses historical symbols and institutional memory.
events.basis: SecDef Pete Hegseth announced the Pentagon would reinstall the memorial at Arlington less than 2 years after it was removed on the recommendation of an independent commission.

events.title: U.S. Air Force denies early retirement to transgender service members
events.summary: The U.S. Air Force announced it is denying early retirement to all transgender service members with 15–18 years of military service, forcing them out without retirement benefits. Previously approved early retirements were rescinded. Affected service members face the choice of quitting or being forced out without vesting retirement benefits.
events.why_relevant: The denial of earned retirement benefits to a specific class of service members based on identity constitutes potential discrimination and breach of commitment to military personnel.
events.basis: The US Air Force is denying early retirement to all transgender service members with between 15-18 years of military service, opting instead to force them out with no retirement benefits.
